items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Buddy said that there were a few little things missing... Buddy sort of spread out a rumor that he was going to give a little reward for the stuff if it showed up.

ctx.x: Do you just want to say a sentence or two about the case of -- just to give a sense of the kind things you have to put up with running a project like this in South Bronx.
Well, we found out when I came in here, Buddy said that there were a few little things missing, like his camera and some nails and a frisbee and a hammer and a basketball --
